title: Kenyan Pancakes with Honey
community: Urban Kenya — the hotel breakfast favourite
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Pancakes with Honey — thick, fluffy American-style pancakes served in a stack with Kenyan wild honey, fresh butter, sliced banana, and passion fruit. The hotel breakfast that children choose — and adults secretly prefer too.
longDesc: Fluffy pancakes at a Kenyan hotel are done the American way — thick, airy stacks served with Kenyan honey that gives them a more complex sweetness than maple syrup. The banana and passion fruit make them unmistakably Kenyan.
steps: Combine wet and dry — mix until just combined. Lumps are fine. Do not over-mix.
Heat pan over medium heat. Brush with butter.
Pour ¼ cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form on the surface and edges look set — 2—3 minutes.
Top with butter, honey, banana, and passion fruit.
chefTips: Do not over-mix — a few lumps produce fluffier pancakes (over-mixing develops gluten).
Bubbles on the surface signal it is time to flip — not before.
Keep cooked pancakes warm in the oven at 80°C while making the batch.
commonMistakes: Flipping too early — not cooked through.
cookingScience: The bicarbonate of soda reacts with the acid in buttermilk to produce CO2 — this is the primary leavening in pancakes. Over-mixing destroys the CO2 bubbles before they can set during cooking and also develops too much gluten, both of which produce dense, flat pancakes.
sustainabilityTips: Kenyan wild honey from highland forests supports beekeeping conservation.
culturalNote: Kenyan hotel pancakes with wild honey and banana represent the perfect fusion of international brunch culture with Kenya's agricultural gifts — the honey and fruit make them uniquely and joyfully Kenyan.
